name: minimal-agent-harness
description: A minimalistic agent harness — sidebar chat with file read/write and command execution, powered by the official DeepSeek API.

agentHarness.apiKey.markdownDescription: DeepSeek API key. Get one at https://platform.deepseek.com. Alternatively set the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable.

agentHarness.model.markdownDescription: DeepSeek model to use. `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` accept image input (attach/paste images in the chat).

agentHarness.commandTimeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a command may run before being killed.

agentHarness.maxTurns.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per user message to prevent runaway loops.

agentHarness.contextWindow.description: Context window (in tokens) for the context-usage indicator. Leave 0 to auto-detect from the selected model.

agentHarness.thinkingEffort.description: How much effort the model should spend reasoning before answering. 'none' uses the API default; 'low'/'medium'/'high' send a reasoning_effort hint (supported by DeepSeek reasoner models).

agentHarness.foldToolCalls.description: Collapse tool-call cards by default in the chat tree; expand them by clicking the header.

agentHarness.foldThinking.description: Collapse the reasoning/thinking block by default in the chat tree; expand it by clicking its header.

agentHarness.maxConcurrentSubagents.description: How many level-1 sub-agents the main agent may run concurrently (a slot pool; extra tasks queue).

agentHarness.maxLevel2Subagents.description: How many sub-sub-agents each sub-agent may start. Depth is hard-capped at 2 (no sub-sub-sub-agent).

agentHarness.saveSubAgentTranscripts.description: Write each finished sub-agent's full conversation to disk as JSONL (one API message per line, meta + tool-call stats on line 1) and hand its path back to the caller.

agentHarness.subAgentTranscriptDir.description: Folder for sub-agent transcripts, relative to the workspace root (a per-session subfolder is created inside). Leave empty to use the extension's global storage.

agentHarness.maxInlineToolOutput.description: Maximum size (bytes) of a search_files / list_dir result returned inline. Larger results are written to a temp file and only its path plus a short preview are returned. Set 0 to always inline.

agentHarness.httpApi.enabled.description: Expose a local HTTP control plane on 127.0.0.1 (bearer-token gated) so an external controller such as tools/hyper-vscode can read state, wait for the agent to go idle, navigate to a node, and continue from it. Off by default; /continue lets the caller make the agent run an instruction, so treat it as a local-trust boundary.

agentHarness.httpApi.port.description: Port for the HTTP control plane. 0 picks a free port; the chosen port and token are written to <globalStorage>/http/<instanceId>.json for the supervisor to discover.
